! =====================================================================
! Script Cisco IOS - Roteador Operadora (ISP-WAN - 2911)
! Projeto: SmartRetail Network (Ana Fashion) - UniFECAF
! Passo 6: Simulacao do Enlace WAN e Rede Externa (8.8.8.0/24)
! =====================================================================

enable
configure terminal

hostname ISP-WAN
no ip domain-lookup

interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description LINK_PARA_CLOUD_ANAFASHION
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description REDE_INTERNET_SIMULADA
 ip address 8.8.8.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit

end
write memory
